root.text: Stillsand is an ocean of apparently empty sand beneath a sun that never sets, crossed by giants. Fortunes scattered among distant rock islands and uncertain caves draw repeated expeditions. Exploring and securing an island makes a dependable harbour, and a useful cave discovery supplies or funds the next expedition or outpost. Learning to live here uses sunlight and desert resources to make glass and lenses, cook food and recover water.

answer.text: Stillsand is an ocean of apparently empty sand beneath a sun that never sets, crossed by giants. Fortunes scattered among distant rock islands and uncertain caves draw repeated expeditions. Exploring and securing an island makes a dependable harbour, and a useful cave discovery supplies or funds the next expedition or outpost. Learning to live here uses sunlight and desert resources to make glass and lenses, cook food and recover water.
